name: ops-room
description: Hackathon starter: an ops room with a REST API, a live board, an MCP server and an AI watchkeeper, all on one Cloudflare Worker.

MODEL.description: The [Workers AI model](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/) your watchkeeper thinks with. The default works on the free plan.

MODEL_FALLBACK.description: The model that steps in when the first one is slow or failing. Leave it as it is.

EXCON_URL.description: Exercise control for the event. Your ops room reports here so it shows on the big screen. Leave it as it is, or empty it to run on your own.

OPS.description: Your ops room's database: a Durable Object with SQLite that holds stores, requests, sites and the mission board.

Watchkeeper.description: Your AI watchkeeper. Every chat session gets its own instance.
